Desktop clock

The same friend lives on your Windows desktop, keeping the time and reminding you about meals and walks. Its schedule and records are stored separately from this screen.

DownloadWindows 10 · 11 (64-bit) · about 110MB
  1. Double-click the file you downloaded.MungnyangClock Setup.exe
  2. When the blue window appears, More info → Run.That window appears because the program is new to Windows. Click the small More info link to reveal the Run button.
  3. Leave the install location as it is and Install.No administrator rights needed.
  4. The clock appears at the bottom right of the screen.A paw icon also appears at the right end of the taskbar.

Time made of little footsteps

Your friend A minute hand of eight kibble pieces one piece at a time. It takes 45 seconds to move to the next minute, then 15 seconds to walk back out.

At meal or walk time your friend waits for you. Once you have done it, ’Done’ and it stays in today’s record. Preview is not counted in your real records.

Styling to change your friend, the clock face, the name and the birthday. Up to four friends can push together, and everyone rests from 10 PM to 7 AM.

Open this HTML file in a browser and it just works. Settings and records are saved in that browser. If the file location or the browser changes, saved data may not carry over. Reminders do not ring while the browser is closed.
